title: openrouter.decisions.response.v1
description: Verified wire format returned by POST https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions on HTTP 200, per docs/PI/pi_jev_m0_provider_protocol_de.md section 1 (real response captured 2026-09-22, content redacted/synthetic). Untrusted input: decisionsService.ts must validate against this schema and reject anything else BEFORE constructing a pi.decisions.response.v1 -- an unknown answer type, a non-finite probability, or an extra field is a hard rejection, not a best-effort parse.

model.description: The actually-processing model build, e.g. "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917" -- OpenRouter appends its own date-stamped build suffix; this is NOT the same format as TypeSafe's own pinned jev-1.13.0. Maps to pi.decisions.response.v1.model_reported verbatim, format differences and all.

cost.description: USD, per-call cost as billed by OpenRouter. Not present on the TypeSafe-direct API's usage object; log this for M3's cost-visibility concern.

id.description: OpenRouter generation id for this decisions call.

provider.description: Upstream provider name as disclosed by OpenRouter, e.g. "TypeSafe".

probabilities.description: Every value MUST be finite and in [0,1]; a NaN/Infinity anywhere rejects the whole response.

noulAnswer.description: Not empirically verified against this endpoint yet (pi_jev_m0_provider_protocol_de.md section 6); shape carried over from the TypeSafe primitive contract.

scoreAnswer.description: Not used by this project; not empirically verified against this endpoint.
